```
r89  b"\x85"   -> \x85       r89  b"\xc2\x85" -> \x85      # identical
```

pair inside the swept set collides on either tool.

sharing the first 100 and last 99 bytes but differing in the dropped middle (`b"z"*100+b"a"*50+b"y"*99` vs
`b"z"*100+b"a"*49+b"y"*99`) render the same 200-character body — measured, and unavoidable at any bound. That is
not the finding; the finding above is the per-byte ambiguity inside the window, where nothing is dropped at all —

requires and which r88 did not have.
